Excalibur Onyx Skin.text: Previously available through the Steam store when purchasing an eligible Pinnacle Pack.

Necramech Summon.text: Automatically acquired after building the first Necramech; it can be equipped in the Gear wheel after completing The War Within.

Shedu Day of the Dead Skin.text: Previously awarded at Rank 4 in Nora's Mix: Dreams of the Dead; that season has ended.

Conquera Ribbon.text: Obtainable as an annual Conquera fundraiser reward for 1 donation each time Warframe starts a charity fund for the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation.

Cranial Foremount.text: Obtained by filleting Myxostomata at Daughter in the Necralisk.

Dex Furis.text: Available through yearly Warframe anniversary Alerts in March; the weapon is awarded with a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Emissary Emblem.text: Awarded by Nora Night upon attaining Rank 9 in Nightwave Series 2.

Hound.text: Vanquishing a Sister of Parvos rewards the player's Hound as a Companion.

Ki'Teer Fireworks.text: Purchased from Baro Ki'Teer as a set of 10 charges for 100,000 Credits and 50 Ducats.

Lazulite Toroid.text: Dropped by the Exploiter Orb during the Deck 12 portion of Operation: Buried Debts; redeeming it awards 12,000 standing with Vox Solaris.

Protea Prime Chronorum Helmet.text: Acquired by purchasing Protea Prime Access.

Saturn Six Emblem.text: Awarded by Nora Night upon attaining Rank 9 in Nightwave Series 1.

Sevati Sekhara.text: Awarded by the Lotus via mail after completing The Law of Retribution for the first time.

Sling Stone Emblem.text: Awarded to players who participated in the Sling-Stone Event and obtained at least one point before the event ended.

Zealot Derelict Code.text: Obtained by completing three Infestation Outbreak missions during Nightwave Series 2; only one code can be obtained per Infested Outbreak across a planet until it is resolved.

Conquera Shoulder Ribbon.text: Obtainable as an annual Conquera fundraiser reward for 1 donation each time Warframe starts a charity fund for the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation.

Crescent Vulpaphyla.text: Obtained through Revivification with Son in the Necralisk after capturing a Weakened Crescent Vulpaphyla during the Vome cycle; Mutagen and Antigen components are purchased from Son with Entrati Standing.

Dex Laurus Ephemera.text: Available through the annual Warframe Anniversary event.

Enigma Sense.text: Purchased from Acrithis for 10 Pathos Clamps and 5 Enigma Gyrum.

Huras Kubrow.text: Requires the Howl of the Kubrow quest, a Kubrow Egg from Kubrow Dens on Earth, and a built Incubator Power Core whose blueprint is obtained from the Market.

Ivara Obsidian Skin.text: Previously available through the PlayStation Store via Renown Pack XI and the Ultimate Obsidian Collection.

Ki'Teer Nobilis Signa.text: Obtained from Baro Ki'Teer's Void Surplus at a 5% drop rate plus 4% per opened Void Surplus, awarded alongside other items.

Liset.text: Acquired during the Awakening introduction quest as the first Landing Craft, along with its ship segments.

Magnus Tekelu Skin.text: Permanently available from the in-game Market for 20 Platinum, separately or as part of The Tekelu Collection III bundle for 80 Platinum.

Protovyre Apex Chest Armor.text: Obtained by killing 375 Sentient enemies while the Protovyre Emergent Shoulder, Chest, and Leg Plate Armor are equipped.

Redeemer Abysso Skin.text: Earned by completing the first mission of the Dog Days Tactical Alert.

Smeeta Kavat.text: Requires the Howl of the Kubrow quest, a Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment, 10 Kavat Genetic Codes from scanning Feral Kavats, and a built Incubator Power Core; the segment blueprint comes from Clan Dojo research, Hyekka Masters, or the Market.

Verglas Prime.text: Automatically acquired upon obtaining Nautilus Prime.

Dex Nikana.text: Available through yearly Warframe anniversary Alerts in March; the weapon is awarded with a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Hildryn Prime Theme.text: The Somachord version can be purchased from Varzia for 5 Aya.

Hydroid Prime Theme.text: The Somachord version can be purchased from Varzia for 5 Aya.

Izvara Solstice Syandana.text: Obtained as the Tennobaum 2017 Ultimate Goal Reward; no current acquisition route is listed.

Protovyre Apex Ephemera.text: Obtained by earning 500,000 Focus from Focus Lenses while the Protovyre Emergent Ephemera is equipped; Focus conversion from Eidolon Shards does not count.

Rell's Donda.text: Purchased from Palladino in Iron Wake for 25 Platinum after completing the Chains of Harrow quest.

Spinal Core Section.text: Obtained by filleting Chondricord and Vitreospina from the Cambion Drift at Daughter in the Necralisk.

Thermian RPG.text: Appears in Höllvania missions and can be acquired during the Convoy Chase section of The Hex quest, from parachuting Scaldra or Eximus, from the H-09 Efervon Tank Assassination, or as specified by related activities and abilities.

Zenurik Badge.text: Purchased from the Zenurik Focus Represent shop for 1,000,000 Focus.

Corpus Cipher.text: Previously awarded from special alerts during Operation: Arid Fear; it was one of the components required to create a Corpus Void Key.

Grakata Towsun Skin.text: Automatically obtained with Twin Grakatas Towsun Skin, purchased from Baro Ki'Teer for 300,000 Credits and 300 Ducats when in stock.

Hypatia Ephemera.text: Obtained from defeating a Radiation Sister of Parvos when she has the Ephemera; Sisters have a 20% chance to appear with an Ephemera depending on the Warframe used.

Jade Follox Sugatra.text: No longer available; originally obtainable for Xbox players from September 17 to October 9, 2020 as part of the game's 6th Xbox anniversary.

Protovyre Apex Leg Plate Armor.text: Obtained by killing 375 Sentient enemies while the Protovyre Emergent Shoulder, Chest, and Leg Plate Armor are equipped.

Protovyre Emergent Leg Plate Armor.text: Obtained by killing 95 Sentient enemies while the Protovyre Shoulder, Chest, and Leg Plate Armor are equipped.

Spring Step Ephemera.text: Previously obtained from the in-game Market for 5,000 Credits during the listed Spring Step availability periods.

Stratos Emblem.text: Awarded for completing a Stratos Challenge during a Tactical Alert; it can be acquired once per Tactical Alert.

Jordas Sekhara.text: Awarded by the Lotus via mail after completing The Jordas Verdict trial for the first time.

Kyruna Ephemera.text: Obtained from defeating an Impact Sister of Parvos when she has the Ephemera; Sisters have a 20% chance to appear with an Ephemera depending on the Warframe used.

Nidina Armor Solstice Leg Plate.text: Not obtainable; originally awarded to all players for achieving a Tennobaum 2025 goal.

Protovyre Apex Shoulder Armor.text: Obtained by killing 375 Sentient enemies while the Protovyre Emergent Shoulder, Chest, and Leg Plate Armor are equipped.

Lacera Scorn Skin.text: Previously obtained from Operation: Shadow Debt after completing 15 waves against the final challenger.

Protovyre Apex Syandana.text: Obtained by collecting 75 Void Relics and Aya from missions while the Protovyre Emergent Syandana is equipped; purchasing Relic Packs does not count.

Adarza Kavat.text: Requires the Howl of the Kubrow quest, the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment, 10 Kavat Genetic Codes from scanning Feral Kavats, and a built Incubator Power Core. A Random Incubation can produce an Adarza Kavat; two Genetic Code Templates can be used for a chance to pass on genetic traits.

Sahasa Kubrow.text: Requires the Howl of the Kubrow quest, a Kubrow Egg from Kubrow Dens on Earth, and a built Incubator Power Core. A Random Incubation can produce a Sahasa Kubrow; two Genetic Code Templates can be used for a chance to pass on genetic traits.

Archgun Deployer.text: Obtained through the player's Inbox after completing the third phase of the Profit-Taker Orb Heist.

Arca Titron Raya Skin.text: Obtained by reaching Rank 4 in Nightwave: Nora's Mix Volume 9, available from May 21, 2025 to October 27, 2025.

Artifex Prime Syandana.text: Acquired through Xaku Prime Access or from Prime Resurgence for 2 Regal Aya when in rotation.

Aseron Sekhara.text: Awarded by the Lotus via Inbox after completing Nightmare The Law of Retribution for the first time.

Aspirant Syandana.text: Obtained during the limited-time Operation: Atramentum event for 60 Nightmare Tatters.

Glaive Daybreak Skin.text: Obtained by reaching Rank 2 in Nightwave: Nora's Mix Volume 6, available from May 15, 2024 to September 3, 2024.

Verv Ephemera.text: Available from Varzia's Prime Resurgence Market for 1 Regal Aya.

Cychel Glaive Skin.text: Available during Tennobaum; players who logged in during the event received it via Inbox.

Dex Signa.text: Awarded for the 13th Anniversary: log in between March 13, 2026 at 11:00 AM ET and December 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET.

Dex Sybaris.text: Obtainable through yearly Warframe anniversaries in March via Alerts; it includes a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Diraeus Signa.text: Obtained by reaching Rank 22 in Nightwave: Nora's Mix: Time Tempests.

Diwata Mot Skin.text: Available in the Market as part of the Titania Empress Skin for 165 Platinum or the Titania Empress Collection for 275 Platinum.

Excalibur Umbra Sunder Helmet.text: Received in the Inbox after completing The Sacrifice quest.

Excalibur Umbra Therion Helmet.text: Given as compensation to players who purchased the China Founders Pack before The Sacrifice update in Warframe China; not available elsewhere.

Gradivus: Sacrifice Emblem.text: Awarded during The Gradivus Dilemma to players who fought at least five missions for the Corpus and won more battles for the Corpus than the Grineer.

Harmony Ribbon.text: Purchasable from the in-game Market for 1 Credit.

Invati Sekhara.text: Awarded by Ordis in recognition of the Trials missions; Trials are currently unavailable.

Nightwave Emblem.text: Awarded by Nora Night at Rank 21 in Nightwave Series 1 or Rank 4 in Intermission III.

Pistol Ammo Box.text: Previously available as a Login Reward; it is no longer obtainable through the Market.

Rifle Ammo Box.text: Previously available as a Login Reward; it is no longer obtainable through the Market. It can very rarely be dropped by the Fossa boss.

Sniper Ammo Box.text: Previously available as a Login Reward; it is no longer obtainable through the Market.

Loiaus Chest Medallion.text: Obtainable from the Operations listed on the Warframe Wiki page.

Protovyre Emergent Ephemera.text: Earn 250,000 Focus from Focus Lenses with the Protovyre Ephemera equipped; Focus conversion from Eidolon Shards does not count.

War Prime.text: Acquired upon crafting Hunhow's Trinket, purchased from Hunhow in Pontis Tower after Jade Shadows: Constellations with 12 Emerald Talent and 12 Crimson Talent awarded from Uranus Proxima. It includes a Weapon Slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.
